name: Danganronpa Mauve -Iwada Hilutowa Bittul-eojin Hag-won-
source:
Danganronpa Mauve is a Korean fangame developed by Team Mob (팀 모브) using RPG Maker VX Ace.

Hope's Peak Academy trains high school students with outstanding talent in specific fields.

Hiruto Iwada, an ordinary high school student, wins the annual lottery, receives the 'Super High School Level Luck' status, and enters Hope's Peak Academy.

However, what greeted him was not a welcome greeting, but a window blocked by thick steel plates, 14 unfamiliar classmates, and a somewhat gloomy-looking academy...

[From [url=https://danganronpamauve.tistory.com/]the official site[/url]]
translation:
Danganronpa Mauve是Team Mob (팀 모브) 使用RPG Maker VX Ace开发的一款韩国同人游戏。

希望之峰学院培养在特定领域具有杰出才能的高中生。

普通高中生岩田博人在年度抽签中中奖，获得“超高校级幸运”身份，进入希望之峰学园。

然而，迎接他的并不是欢迎的问候，而是一扇被厚钢板堵住的窗户，十四个陌生的同学，还有一所看上去有些阴森的学院……

[来自[url=https://danganronpamauve.tistory.com/]官方网站[/url]]
